sourceLabel: Official New York utility benchmark guidance

notes: This build ships New York as an official utility-benchmark market because the public Power to Choose offer board was offline for maintenance.
While the public offer board is offline, current residential-serving electric suppliers are pulled from the live official NY DPS ESCO directory and grouped by utility territory.

ZIP-to-utility mapping is exact for Con Edison's published ZIP load-zone lists and Long Island overrides, and otherwise conservative from the official NY ZIP/county file plus official utility service-territory guidance.
